Settings ModalCompound

One Copilot Settings dialog. A full-width header (Settings + dismiss) over a two-pane body: a text-only left nav rail and a right content pane. Shows the Sources section — a managed source list (chevron rows) plus a Browse sources block with an inline search and Connect rows.
